standard_prerequisites.name: Universal delta-functors and effaceability
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard homological algebra; the proof uses that an effaceable delta-functor is universal and that two universal delta-functors agreeing in degree 0 agree everywhere
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two general facts combined in the proof; the identification of effaceability with the previous lemma is the counted step.

core_obligations: Establish effaceability: by the acyclicity lemma for injective presheaves, each functor H^p-check(U, -) can be effaced, hence the sequence of functors H^p-check(U, -) on PAb(C) is a universal delta-functor (proof lines 1731-1733).

Compare two universal delta-functors: the right derived functors of H^0-check(U, -) form another universal delta-functor on PAb(C), and it agrees with H^p-check(U, -) in degree 0 because H^0-check is by definition the degree-zero functor (proof lines 1734-1736).

Conclude by universality: two universal delta-functors which agree in degree 0 have canonically isomorphic higher terms, so H^p-check(U, -) are the right derived functors of H^0-check(U, -) (proof lines 1734-1738).
proof_roadmap: Use the vanishing of Cech cohomology of an injective presheaf in positive degrees to see that the Cech functors are effaceable, hence universal (proof lines 1731-1733).
Observe that the right derived functors of H^0-check are also a universal delta-functor and agree in degree 0 (proof lines 1734-1736).
Apply the uniqueness of universal delta-functors with a degree-zero isomorphism to identify the two families (proof lines 1736-1738).
difficulty_reason: The theorem identifies the Cech cohomology functors of a family U on the category of abelian presheaves with the right derived functors of its degree-zero part H^0-check(U, -) (statement lines 1725-1727). The proof is a comparison of delta-functors and its crux is to see that effaceability is available: this is exactly what the preceding vanishing on injective presheaves supplies, and it is why the theorem is placed after that lemma (proof lines 1731-1733). Once both families are universal delta-functors agreeing in degree 0, uniqueness finishes the proof, and the author points to the corresponding statement in the sites chapter for further details (proof line 1737). The claim is H2: a short structural argument whose content is the choice of the right general theorem to invoke.
